scope: One authenticated Shop selling device per workspace; native completed sales only
authorization: Verified named Supabase Auth session, active workspace membership, Shop activation entitlement and commerce.write capability; Ecommerce-only activation is denied

bindingRequest.workspaceId: trusted workspace ID repeated for mismatch rejection
bindingRequest.deviceId: canonical lowercase UUID persisted by the client

saleRequest.workspaceId: trusted workspace ID repeated for mismatch rejection

payload.createdAtMillis: native sale timestamp in Unix milliseconds

retryRule: Same workspace, device, operation and canonical sale returns the original acknowledgement; changed sale details conflict
stockRule: Exactly one negative stock movement per distinct product line in the sale transaction; no stock balance merge in v1
